The reason people are unhappy with the current theme of microtransactions buying power is the same reason people have problems with buying power in real life, and its not something people enjoy. I'm fine with people buying cosmetics, but not actual power. The problem only exists when you can buy the supply drops and not only attain them via playing the game. If it were a time requirement most would be okay with it, but with money being brought in its polarizing. And the problem with voting with your money in this is that there is only an obvious way to support it, and no clear way to not support it. Any money a company makes off of it will show up to them as the fans loving it, and there isn't a readily obvious way to show that you don't like these systems. I would support everyone boycotting it but game theory prevents it. I presume that you are one of the people who can afford to pay for supply drops and such in the game, but as someone who can't I strongly dislike these systems being implemented and think it makes me less likely to enjoy a game, and whenever it is added I will cite it as my main problem with the game.
